complete_examples.text: Apart from the model validations, the application of this model in engineering practices, such as the vehicle-induced vibration of the continuously welded rail (CWR), has been revealed, and some conclusions are drawn from the numerical studies.

In this section, the e®ects of thermal load, misalignment defect and curved track parameters on the vehicle-induced vibration of CWR are analyzed in detail, and some responses are presented to evaluate the service performance of the vehicle–track system.
